title: fix(service-settings)!: Setup's default language offers and accepts the languages the deployment supports, not four hard-coded ones
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg21NveYnJ8STuX2gJsTgYaA)_

domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** Setup → 本地化 →「默认语言」不再写死四种语言，改成部署实际支持的语言：和用户右上角语言菜单读同一个来源（i18n 服务的 `getLocales()`，即 `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`），选项每次打开页面、每次保存时现读，所以后加的翻译项（比如越南语）马上就能选；每个选项用该语言自己的名字显示（简体中文、日本語、Tiếng Việt）。
- **为什么改：** 法国客户有完整法语包、用户菜单能选法语，但组织默认语言只能在英/中/日/西四种里选，存 `fr-FR`、`vi-VN` 一律被拒，每个新用户都从公司没选的语言起步。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是一次收窄（`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`）：部署不支持的语言以后存不进去，例如应用只声明 `en`、`zh-CN` 时，以前能存的 `ja-JP`、`es-ES` 现在被拒。已经存着的旧值照常生效、照常可读，页面上显示为「（已不再提供）」，保存别的字段不受影响；只有再次写入它才会被拒。`en-US` 这类老写法在部署提供 `en` 时照常接受。没有 i18n 服务的组合仍用原来四种。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/services/service-settings/src/localization-locale-options.ts`（来源、命名、接受规则、"已不再提供"）；`settings-service.ts` 里新的 `registerOptionSource` / `optionTableOf` / `servedManifest` 三段，以及保存和环境变量两处改成问 `optionTableOf` 的两行；`settings-service-plugin.ts` 在注册清单之前注册这个来源的那一段。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/localization-locale-options.test.ts`，预期 14 条全绿，其中"后加的翻译项不重启即可保存"和"已不再提供的旧值照常可读并标注"两条。
- **需要你做的：** 这是 BREAKING 收窄，合入需要你本人同意（合约审查由席位安排）。

Fixes #30286

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `SettingsService` gains `registerOptionSource(namespace, key, source)` and the package exports the `SettingsOptionSource`, `SettingsOptionSourceAnswer` and `SettingsServedOption` types; `getNamespace` takes an optional third `display` argument. The save of `localization.locale` (`PUT /api/settings/localization`, `SettingsService.setMany`) and an `OS_LOCALIZATION_LOCALE` override now accept the i18n service's locale list instead of the declared `en-US`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`: a language the deployment supports is accepted where it was refused (`fr-FR`, `vi-VN`), and one of the four the deployment does not support is refused where it was accepted (`ja-JP` on an app that declares `i18n.supportedLocales: ['en', 'zh-CN']`, as `examples/app-showcase` and `examples/app-crm` do).
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n "localization.locale" skills content/docs` answers one line, `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx:474` (SMS bodies fall back to the setting), which lists no values and stays true; `skills/**` names the setting nowhere.

## What changes

**A settings key can serve its options from the running system (`SettingsService`, `settings-service.ts`, `settings-service.types.ts`).** Measured first: a settings option table was recorded once, from the manifest, at `registerManifest`; the `valueDomain` vocabulary is closed (three members) and `bcp47_locale` is refused by name in `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts`, because this key's options were meant to be the supported set, not a standard. So no existing mechanism and no spec change: a service-level registration, `registerOptionSource(namespace, key, source)`. The source answers `{ options, admits(value) }`, or `undefined` to leave the declared table standing.

- **Save** (`validatePatch`) and **`OS_*` override** (`effectiveEnvOverride`) both ask one helper, `optionTableOf`, for the values offered and the judgment of a written value: the source's answer when it has one, else the declared table through `firstRejectedOption`, unchanged. Each site changes by two lines; the refusal is the existing `invalid_option` with `constraint.allowed` listing the offered values. The TOUCH gate is unchanged, so a stored value is judged only by a save that writes it.
- **Registration-time env audit** (`auditEnvOverrides`) skips the options family of a sourced key: the source reads a service that registers later in the boot, so a verdict there would come from the table it replaces. The override is judged when read, by the same helper (`AGENTS.md`, Startup registry reads).
- **Page read** (`getNamespace`, optional `display.locale`; the `GET /api/settings/:namespace` route passes the request's language, one line) serves a copy of the manifest whose sourced specifiers carry the source's options for the value in effect. The registered manifest is never changed. `GET /api/settings` (the manifest list) still serves the declared table.
- A source that throws is answered as absent (declared table) and logged once per cause at `warn`.

**`localization.locale`'s source (`localization-locale-options.ts`, new).** Offered codes = the i18n service's `getLocales()`, de-duplicated, in its order: the app's declared `i18n.supportedLocales`, else every loaded bundle and authored translation item, the list `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales` serves to the language menu.

- **Names** in their own language: the platform locale table's name (`PLATFORM_LOCALES`, #30001) for the language the code means through `platformLocaleTagOf`, else `Intl.DisplayNames([code])` with `fallback: 'none'`, capitalized, else the code. The console's language menu names locales the same way (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx`, `localeLabel`).
- **Accepted:** each offered code, and a stored spelling of an offered table language (`en-US` where `en` is offered, `zh-CN` where `zh-Hans` is), through the table's read aliases. Without this the manifest default `en-US` would not be a member on any deployment whose list says `en`, which is all three examples. A code the table does not alias is accepted only as spelled (`fr-FR` is not `fr`).
- **The value in effect:** a stored second spelling is served under its own spelling so the select shows it chosen; a stored value no longer offered is served as an extra option named `NAME (no longer offered)` in the reader's language (en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES), so the page shows it rather than a blank select.
- No i18n service, or one reporting nothing ⇒ the declared four stand.

**Wiring (`settings-service-plugin.ts`).** `init` registers the source before the manifests, with `ctx.getService('i18n')` asked at each use.

**Translations (`translations/zh-CN.ts`).** The bundle translated the four option names (英语(美国), 日语, …). The console's option-label lookup prefers the bundle over the served name, so those entries would have named each language in the reader's language; they are removed. The other three bundles carried none. The coverage guard already excludes option labels for this reason (`settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` header).

**Manifest (`localization.manifest.ts`).** The declared four stay as the no-i18n fallback; a comment says what a running deployment serves instead.

### Readers of `localization.locale` (the card's question)

None breaks on a locale outside the four; each was read on `origin/main` fe835b49, not exercised end to end:

| Reader | Where | With `vi-VN` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Execution context locale (number/date formatting, `resolveLocalizationContext`) | `packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts`, `resolve-authz-context.ts` | `Intl` formats any BCP 47 tag. |
| Auth email locale | `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` (`applyLocalizationLocale`), `auth-manager.ts` (`normalizeAuthEmailLocale`) | Passed through unchanged; `EmailService.sendTemplate`'s ladder finds no `vi-VN` row and falls to `en-US` (`plugin-email/src/email-service.ts`). `en` still maps to `en-US`. |
| Auth SMS bodies | `plugin-auth/src/phone-sms-texts.ts` | `phoneSmsLocaleChain` ends at `en`; never renders nothing. |
| Seed dataset locale | `packages/runtime/src/seed-locale.ts` → `metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` (`filterByLocale`) | Datasets scoped to other locales are skipped and named in one log line; unscoped ones load, as for any unmatched locale. |
| Activity summaries, @mention titles | `plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`, `audit-writers.ts` | i18n `t()` falls back to the default locale. |
| Messaging template locale | `service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts` | Names the setting in a comment only; reads `i18n.getDefaultLocale()` at delivery, unset lands the `en-US` default. Unaffected. |
| `GET /auth/me/localization` | `plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts` | Echoes the value; the console shows English for a language with no console pack, as its language menu already does. |

## Tests

New `src/localization-locale-options.test.ts` (14 tests), on a real `LiteKernel` boot of `SettingsServicePlugin` with a stand-in i18n service whose list the cases change, through the real settings routes (`GET` / `PUT /api/settings/:namespace`):

- serves the list, named in each language, with `en-US` in effect shown as the `en` option; the registered manifest unchanged;
- accepts `fr-FR` when offered; follows the list at runtime (`vi-VN` refused, then accepted after the list grows, no reboot);
- refuses an unoffered `ja-JP`: 400 `SETTINGS_VALIDATION`, `invalid_option` at `locale`, `constraint.allowed: 'en, zh-CN'`, nothing written;
- accepts `zh-CN` / `en-US` where `zh-Hans` / `en` are offered, refuses `fr-FR` where `fr` is;
- a stored `ja-JP` the list drops: still the value, served as `日本語 (已不再提供)` for a zh-CN reader, a save of `fiscal_year_start` passes, a re-write of `ja-JP` is refused;
- empty list ⇒ the declared four;
- `OS_LOCALIZATION_LOCALE=vi-VN` in force while offered, not in force once the list drops it; not reported by the registration-time audit while a declared-table key (`fiscal_year_start`) still is;
- no source ⇒ declared table; a throwing source ⇒ declared table, one `warn`;
- `localeSelfName`: table names, the code for an unnamed tag, a malformed tag and a runtime without `Intl.DisplayNames`, and the runtime's ICU name for `vi-VN`.

Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `optionTableOf` made to ignore the source ⇒ 6 of 14 red; restored, blob equal to `HEAD`.

Package: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` 69 files, 1170 passed; `typecheck` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Setup's renderer needs no change: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` draws a `select` from the served `spec.options` and names each through `labels.optionLabel`, which falls back to the served label when the bundle has no entry. Read, not changed (`ui/**` is out of scope).
- #30206 (first-run checklist language row) should read the same list: `GET /api/settings/localization`'s served `locale` options, or the i18n service's `getLocales()` server-side. No change here.
- The new component's pins are in its own test file (`localization-locale-options.test.ts`); the settings routes' shared harness (`settings-routes.test.ts`) is not extended.
- `GET /api/settings` (the manifest list the Setup hub reads for its navigation) still carries the declared four; only the namespace read serves the live list.

## Verification

All at head `e1c377ef` (the branch with `origin/main` merged), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (exit 0) and a full build (`turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`, 119/119, under the verify lock):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: 69 files, 1170 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 63 families from the change set; each run with its exit recorded before any pipe: 63 of 63 exit 0 (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first answered exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, on the shallow clone; it exits 0 after fetching its pinned fixture commit). `--ran`: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood (BREAKING, narrowing arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: exit 0, 419 files passed and 3 skipped, 3492 tests passed and 36 skipped.
- CI check-runs: not yet reported at opening.
